description: Swift source file defining the ContactsService class, which provides functionalities for searching and adding contacts using the Contacts framework, with additional permission handling and contact matching logic.

classes.name: ContactsService
classes.description: Final class implementing contact search and add services, conforming to ContactsServicing protocol. Handles contact authorization, searching by name or other parameters, adding new contacts, and matching existing contacts.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Asynchronously searches for contacts matching the given parameters, returning a payload of contacts.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a new contact with specified parameters, handling permission checks and existing contact detection.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Checks and manages contact store authorization status.

methods.name: authorizedStore
methods.description: Obtains an authorized CNContactStore, prompting for permissions if necessary.

methods.name: normalizeStrings
methods.description: Normalizes an array of strings, trimming whitespace and optionally lowercasing.

methods.name: findExistingContact
methods.description: Finds an existing contact based on phone numbers or emails.

methods.name: matchContacts
methods.description: Matches a list of contacts against provided phone numbers and emails to find a contact that matches.

methods.name: normalizePhone
methods.description: Normalizes phone number strings to contain only digits.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Creates a payload representation from a CNContact object.
